//: §8 recovery on the same device. The phone's recovery key RK (keys.json recovery_key); rpk = its SPKI, carried in key_reg of every key of that phone. r = LP("AFKLINK-RECOVER-V1") || LP(device_id) || LP(session_id) || LP(key_id_new 32) || LP(nonce_pc 16); rsig = ECDSA(rk, r). Admit wire {kind:"recover", attest:{init_data}, rsig} (no `old` hint). New key = B (key_reg with the same rpk); old record = A of Вера (1001). attest = telegram-attest.json case main. Recovery is always on. §8.4 order: form incl. key_reg.rpk present (recover_malformed); attest (attest_bad / attest_has_hash); candidates = active records with the same rpk AND person == attested uid (recover_no_record); rsig under rpk (recover_bad_sig + journal); then rpk_conflict (the rpk is also on another person's record - generator choice: checked as for every admission), limit; commit: lowest candidate role, unconfirmed if any candidate is, all candidates revoked with origin `replaced`. Case = PC state + one first-offer step through the full §3.4 path -> expect {verdict = signed | key_unconfirmed | §11 reason, detail = ended_detail, admit}. State: keys [{key_id, spki, role, person, kind, platform, rpk?, source, unconfirmed?}], revoked [{key_id, spki, telegram_user_id, origin}], spent ids, snapshot, nonce_batches. A new key whose candidate would be unconfirmed is refused key_unconfirmed in strict mode without any change (generator choice) and is added with verdict key_unconfirmed in observe mode.
